steps: Here Maya uploads a twenty page client contract, and types just two words: summarize this.
In run one, Claude has to fill the blanks itself. For whom, and why? It guesses, and returns a three sentence overview.
Now the same file and the same prompt give a two page bullet list in run two, and a table in run three. The output drifts because nothing was specified.
Her manager spots the gap. Maya said what she wanted, but not who it is for, why, or what format. A good prompt has role, context, task and format.
So Maya rewrites it: a contract analyst role, the C F O as the audience, one page, in three bullet sections.
Claude returns one page with three sections: payment, renewal and liability. With nothing left to guess, reruns converge on the same consistent answer.
Finally, Maya sends the one page summary to the C F O, who reads it before the board meeting. Four elements, one consistent answer.
